records.summary: Added a conditional Binance XRP PoR reserve-wallet stress scenario using The Edge's October 1 snapshot extraction; independently cross-checked the Binance incident with Bitquery and CoinDesk while keeping the XRP-wallet-to-PoR crosswalk explicitly unknown. Added CoinGecko's historical CEX liquidity comparison and captured XRP Insights' internal ETF header/detail discrepancy. Opened three fresh-main safety PRs: #1383 cross-analysis read-only (348 tests + 8 subtests, gate pass), #1384 accuracy evaluator quarantine (348 tests + 8 subtests, gate pass), and #1385 combined task-bundle authoring repair (344 tests + 8 subtests, gate pass). No market features admitted; no directional forecast issued; main unchanged.
